description: Sleek is an AI-powered web app for generating and editing mobile app UI designs from prompts or sketches. It lets users create multi-screen app mockups and export them to Figma or code.
summary: sleek.design exposes one developer integration surface: a documented REST API at `https://sleek.design/api/v1` with a public OpenAPI spec; no public GraphQL API, MCP server, standalone CLI, or other developer-callable surface was found on this domain.
